speaker: Sofia
text: Alright, let's start. This is the planning check-in for the Harbor Data Summit. Today we need to confirm the venue, the speaker lineup, and the catering budget.

speaker: Ben
text: Thanks Sofia. On the venue, Riverside Hall quoted us eleven thousand dollars for two days. The Dockside Center is cheaper at eight thousand five hundred, but it only holds two hundred people, and we already have two hundred forty registrations.

speaker: Tara
text: Then Dockside is out. I would rather pay the extra for Riverside than turn people away.

speaker: Sofia
text: Agreed. The decision is that we book Riverside Hall for the fourth and fifth of June.

speaker: Ben
text: I will send the signed contract and the deposit by Thursday. The deposit is thirty percent.

speaker: Sofia
text: Good. Now speakers. Tara, where are we?

speaker: Tara
text: Four of the six keynotes are confirmed. The open slots are the closing keynote and the privacy engineering workshop. I will email Doctor Alvarez, our first choice for the closing, by Monday. If she declines, we have no closing keynote at all, so that is a risk.

speaker: Ben
text: The caterer needs a final headcount by the twentieth of May, and each lunch is thirty two dollars. For two hundred forty people over two days that is over fifteen thousand dollars, and our food budget is twelve thousand.

speaker: Sofia
text: So we are about three thousand dollars over. Options?

speaker: Tara
text: We could drop the lunch on the second day and offer coffee and snacks instead.

speaker: Sofia
text: I do not love it, but let's decide: day two gets snacks instead of lunch. That brings catering under budget.

speaker: Ben
text: Then I will ask the caterer to re-quote on that basis, and I will have the new number by next Wednesday.

speaker: Sofia
text: Great. One more thing: registration closes in ten days, and the website still shows the old venue. Tara, can you update the website today and post the venue announcement?

speaker: Tara
text: Yes, I will update the website and post the announcement today.

speaker: Sofia
text: Perfect. We will meet again on Monday.
